snippet.title: Trasmoz Legends - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:

#xbox 
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/trasmoz-legends/9p48gsv3z576

The final arcade battle in the cursed lands of Trasmoz begins. Are you ready?

Enter the cursed land of Trasmoz in this pure 8-bit arcade platformer! Face hordes of enemies, unlock multiple game modes, and crush the final boss in a blast of chiptune and pixel blood. Local co-op, speedruns, and great replayability await!

Trasmoz Legends is the explosive finale to the Trasmoz trilogy: a retro arcade platformer built like a lost 1980s cabinet. Featuring ultra-crisp pixel art limited to 16 colors and an authentic YM2203 chiptune soundtrack, it’s a love letter to the golden age of coin-op gaming.

Choose from 4 modes — Family, Classic, Speedrun, and Endless — and face a relentless final boss that hunts you through cursed villages, cryptic forests, and decaying catacombs. Play solo or team up with a friend in the local co-op mode.

With its emergent gameplay, brutal pacing, and deep challenge, Trasmoz Legends is made for both hardcore veterans and curious newcomers.

Features:

– 4 game modes: Family, Classic, Speedrun & Endless  
– True 8-bit style: 16-color sprites & YM2203 chiptune  
– Local co-op for 2 players  
– Leaderboards & achievements  

No filler. Just pure arcade energy.

©2025 JanduSoft & Volcano Bytes
